sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马斯。

sentences.en: If you can recognize any piece of classical music, I bet it's this one.
sentences.zh: 如果你能认出任何一首古典音乐，我敢打赌一定是这一首。

sentences.en: This is Fur Elise, written by Ludwig van Beethoven in 1810.
sentences.zh: 这是《致爱丽丝》，由路德维希·凡·贝多芬于1810年创作。

sentences.en: Maybe it reminds you of piano lessons you took when you were a kid.
sentences.zh: 也许它会让你想起小时候上的钢琴课。

sentences.en: In my town, it was also the song the ice cream truck used to play.
sentences.zh: 在我住的地方，这也是冰淇淋车常放的曲子。

sentences.en: That's producer Avery Troubleman.
sentences.zh: 那是制片人艾弗里·特鲁布曼。

sentences.en: But if you live in Taiwan, and you hear a truck rumbling down the street playing Fur Elise,
sentences.zh: 但如果你住在台湾，听到街上传来播放《致爱丽丝》的卡车轰鸣声，

sentences.en: it doesn't mean it's time to buy a popsicle.
sentences.zh: 那并不意味着该去买冰棒了。

sentences.en: It means it's time to take out your trash.
sentences.zh: 那意味着该倒垃圾了。

sentences.en: Because this is what a garbage truck in Taiwan sounds like.
sentences.zh: 因为这就是台湾垃圾车的声音。

sentences.en: This garbage truck song isn't just supposed to be cute and fun.
sentences.zh: 这首垃圾车之歌不仅仅是为了可爱和有趣。

sentences.en: Although it is also supposed to be cute and fun.
sentences.zh: 虽然它确实也挺可爱有趣的。

sentences.en: The singing garbage trucks are all a part of a completely different way of thinking about waste disposal.
sentences.zh: 这些会唱歌的垃圾车，是完全不同的垃圾处理理念的一部分。

sentences.en: Completely different, that is, from the way that we think about it in the United States.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，与我们在美国所想的完全不同。

sentences.en: In the late 1990s, Taiwan recycled only 5% of its waste.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪90年代末，台湾的垃圾回收率仅为5%。

sentences.en: Today, Taiwan recycles well over half.
sentences.zh: 如今，台湾的回收率已超过一半。

sentences.en: The country is now among the world's top recyclers.
sentences.zh: 该国现在跻身世界顶级回收国家之列。

sentences.en: And what changed in this period has a lot to do with the way that the trash is collected.
sentences.zh: 而这一时期发生的变化，与垃圾收集的方式有很大关系。

sentences.en: Okay, Fur Elise isn't the only song the trucks play.
sentences.zh: 好吧，《致爱丽丝》并不是垃圾车播放的唯一曲目。

sentences.en: In Taipei, the capital of Taiwan, the trucks also play this song.
sentences.zh: 在台湾首府台北，垃圾车还会播放这首歌。

sentences.en: That's A Maiden's Prayer, by Polish composer Tekla Baraszewska-Baranowska.
sentences.zh: 那是波兰作曲家特克拉·巴达捷夫斯卡-巴拉诺夫斯卡创作的《少女的祈祷》。
zh_words: 作曲家特克拉·巴达捷夫斯卡

sentences.en: And in Taipei City, the garbage trucks just alternate between these two songs.
sentences.zh: 在台北市，垃圾车就在这两首歌之间轮换播放。

sentences.en: They take turns to play these two songs, two music, in Taipei City.
sentences.zh: 它们在台北市轮流播放这两首曲子，两首音乐。

sentences.en: Even the elementary school kids can sing the song.
sentences.zh: 连小学生都会唱这首歌。

sentences.en: So, we are brainwashed.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们被洗脑了。

sentences.en: This is Dr. Jasmine Wong, and she grew up in Taipei.
sentences.zh: 这是茉莉·黄博士，她在台北长大。

sentences.en: Since I was a child, I knew that every time when the garbage truck comes, we will hear da-da-da-da-da-da-da.
sentences.zh: 我从小就知道，每次垃圾车一来，我们就会听到哒哒哒哒哒哒哒的声音。

sentences.en: Now the singing garbage trucks are such a part of life, it's hard to imagine a time before them.
sentences.zh: 现在，会唱歌的垃圾车已成为生活的一部分，很难想象没有它们的时候。

sentences.en: But that time actually wasn't too long ago.
sentences.zh: 但那段时光其实并不遥远。

sentences.en: We used to have a lot of big dumpsters.
sentences.zh: 我们过去有很多大垃圾桶。

sentences.en: So, they would have a lot of rats, mosquitoes, and things like that.
sentences.zh: 所以，里面会有很多老鼠、蚊子之类的东西。

sentences.en: And it's not good for our health.
sentences.zh: 这对我们的健康不利。

sentences.en: Just a couple of decades ago, Taipei residents threw their trash into massive, smelly dumpsters on the streets.
sentences.zh: 就在几十年前，台北居民还会把垃圾扔到街上巨大且恶臭的垃圾桶里。

sentences.en: Garbage would end up in piles on the sidewalk and in parks.
sentences.zh: 垃圾最终会堆在人行道和公园里。

sentences.en: It would fester in the heat.
sentences.zh: 它们会在高温下腐烂。

sentences.en: It was just nasty.
sentences.zh: 那真是太糟糕了。

sentences.en: Then, Taiwan's democratization accelerated in the mid-1980s, and created this desire to tidy up.
sentences.zh: 随后，台湾的民主化进程在20世纪80年代中期加速，创造了这种清理环境的愿望。

sentences.en: Being a modern country means being a clean country.
sentences.zh: 成为一个现代国家意味着成为一个干净的国家。

sentences.en: And when you have foreign visitors coming and visiting your capital, they shouldn't think,
sentences.zh: 当你接待外国游客来访你的首都时，他们不应该觉得，

sentences.en: oh, this place is dirty.
sentences.zh: 哦，这个地方很脏。

sentences.en: This is Mary Alice Haddad, chair of East Asian Studies at Wesleyan University.
sentences.zh: 这是玛丽·爱丽丝·哈达德，卫斯理大学东亚研究系主任。

sentences.en: In Taiwan, the pro-democracy movement got fully entangled with the environmental movement.
sentences.zh: 在台湾，民主运动与环保运动完全交织在一起。

sentences.en: And so, as all those things moved together in the late 80s, early 90s,
sentences.zh: 因此，当所有这些事情在80年代末、90年代初共同推进时，

sentences.en: then the pro-democracy and pro-environment agendas got onto the public consciousness.
sentences.zh: 民主和环保议程就进入了公众意识。

sentences.en: Also, the environmental movement had a practical end.
sentences.zh: 此外，环保运动也有其实际目的。

sentences.en: Taiwan was running out of space to actually put piles of trash, because it's a small island, an extremely populous small island.
sentences.zh: 台湾的垃圾堆放空间快用完了，因为它是一个小岛，一个人口极其稠密的小岛。

sentences.en: There's not that much space where you're going to stick all your junk.
sentences.zh: 没有那么多地方可以让你堆放所有的垃圾。

sentences.en: Whereas, in the United States, there has been historically a sense of the untamed, untapped, endless wilderness.
sentences.zh: 而在美国，历史上一直有一种未被驯服、未被开发、无尽荒野的感觉。

sentences.en: And you could just throw your junk into the wilderness, and it would go away, and you wouldn't have to worry about it anymore.
sentences.zh: 你可以把垃圾扔进荒野，它就会消失，你再也不用担心了。

sentences.en: Not true in Taipei.
sentences.zh: 在台北可不行。

sentences.en: It's a big city, but it's really clean, and the subways are clean, and the stores are clean, and the sidewalks are clean, and it's really pleasant to be there.
sentences.zh: 这是一座大城市，但它非常干净，地铁很干净，商店很干净，人行道很干净，待在那里真的很愉快。

sentences.en: You'd never know that the city used to have piles of garbage littering the streets.
sentences.zh: 你永远不会知道这座城市曾经有堆积如山的垃圾散落在街头。

sentences.en: Taipei and a number of other Taiwanese cities reduced the amount of trash by changing the way the trash got collected.
sentences.zh: 台北和其他一些台湾城市通过改变垃圾收集方式减少了垃圾量。

sentences.en: Take a look at my garbage.
sentences.zh: 看看我的垃圾。

sentences.en: This is my friend Erin Newport.
sentences.zh: 这是我的朋友艾琳·纽波特。

sentences.en: She lives in Taipei, where the garbage truck comes five nights a week.
sentences.zh: 她住在台北，那里的垃圾车每周来五晚。

sentences.en: Evenings, like after work.
sentences.zh: 晚上，比如下班后。

sentences.en: It comes Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
sentences.zh: 它在周一、周二、周四、周五和周六来。

sentences.en: In Erin's neighborhood, trucks come twice in the evening, at five and at seven.
sentences.zh: 在艾琳的社区，垃圾车晚上会来两次，分别在五点和七点。

sentences.en: Normally you take out the trash like once a week on one of the days.
sentences.zh: 通常你一周只会在某一天倒一次垃圾。

sentences.en: Ah, yeah, usually once.
sentences.zh: 啊，是的，通常一次。

sentences.en: I mean, it's kind of hard sometimes to find the time to always be home at five or seven.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有时很难找到时间总是在五点或七点待在家里。

sentences.en: Erin has to gather her own garbage and recycling and bring it out to a designated street corner,
sentences.zh: 艾琳必须自己收集垃圾和回收物，并把它们带到指定的街角，

sentences.en: and wait for the big yellow truck to come, with an ear perked for the sound of fear release or a maiden's prayer coming down the block.
sentences.zh: 等待那辆黄色大卡车到来，竖起耳朵听着《致爱丽丝》或《少女的祈祷》穿过街区。

sentences.en: Basically, this is a binless system, or a garbage canless system.
sentences.zh: 基本上，这是一个无垃圾桶系统，或者说没有垃圾箱的系统。

sentences.en: Your trash goes right from your house to the truck, ideally without ever touching the street.
sentences.zh: 你的垃圾直接从家里送到卡车上，理想情况下根本不会接触街道。

sentences.en: You just have to bring out your garbage in a special bag.
sentences.zh: 你只需要用专门的袋子把垃圾带出来。

sentences.en: I pay my garbage bill by purchasing these blue Taipei City garbage bags.
sentences.zh: 我通过购买这些蓝色的台北市垃圾袋来支付垃圾处理费。

sentences.en: These official blue garbage bags say City of Taipei on them.
sentences.zh: 这些官方蓝色垃圾袋上印着“台北市”字样。

sentences.en: And each is emblazoned with a stamp.
sentences.zh: 每一个上面都盖着印章。

sentences.en: I buy them from the convenience store across the street.
sentences.zh: 我从街对面的便利店买它们。

sentences.en: The official blue garbage bags come in a number of different sizes, ranging from three liters to 120 liters.
sentences.zh: 官方蓝色垃圾袋有多种尺寸，从3升到120升不等。

sentences.en: So the more garbage you throw away, the more it'll cost you.
sentences.zh: 所以你扔的垃圾越多，花费就越多。

sentences.en: And although Taipei residents have to pay for their garbage by the bag, recycling and compost are free.
sentences.zh: 虽然台北居民必须按袋支付垃圾费，但回收和堆肥是免费的。

sentences.en: You don't need to buy bags for them at all.
sentences.zh: 你根本不需要为它们买袋子。

sentences.en: You can just take out your recycling in non-official plastic bags, and you can generate as much compost and recycling as you'd like.
sentences.zh: 你可以用非官方的塑料袋带出回收物，而且你可以产生任意多的堆肥和回收物。

sentences.en: So residents are incentivized to recycle more and throw out less.
sentences.zh: 因此，居民们被激励去更多地回收，更少地扔垃圾。

sentences.en: I watched Erin sort out all of her recyclables into perfect categories.
sentences.zh: 我看着艾琳把她所有的可回收物分成了完美的类别。

sentences.en: These are the cans.
sentences.zh: 这些是罐头。

sentences.en: Cans and bottles.
sentences.zh: 罐头和瓶子。

sentences.en: So we have a few tea bottles.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有几个茶瓶。

sentences.en: So in Taipei, every yellow garbage truck is followed by a small, white recycling truck, which is basically a cart full of different bins.
sentences.zh: 在台北，每辆黄色垃圾车后面都跟着一辆白色的小型回收车，基本上是一辆装满不同箱子的手推车。

sentences.en: There's a bin for plastic bottles, one for glass bottles, different metals and cans, papers and cardboards, and a compost bucket for raw food waste,
sentences.zh: 有一个装塑料瓶的箱子，一个装玻璃瓶的，各种金属和罐头，纸张和纸板，还有一个装生厨余的堆肥桶，

sentences.en: and a compost bucket for cooked food waste.
sentences.zh: 以及一个装熟厨余的堆肥桶。

sentences.en: Taipei residents have to sort their recycling into all these different categories themselves.
sentences.zh: 台北居民必须自己将回收物分类到所有这些不同的类别中。

sentences.en: Although in the white recycling trucks, there are officials and volunteers who can help instruct you about which item goes where.
sentences.zh: 虽然在白色回收车上，有官员和志愿者可以指导你哪些物品该放在哪里。

sentences.en: So Erin, her housemates, and I got all of her bags of trash and different kinds of recycling sorted out.
sentences.zh: 所以艾琳、她的室友和我整理好了她所有的垃圾袋和各种回收物。

sentences.en: And then we walked about a block down the street to wait with the rest of her neighbors, who were all clutching official blue garbage bags.
sentences.zh: 然后我们沿着街道走了一个街区，和她的其他邻居一起等待，他们都紧紧抓着官方的蓝色垃圾袋。

sentences.en: Quite a lot of people gathered here today.
sentences.zh: 今天聚集了很多人。

sentences.en: I'd say this is maybe larger than your average crew.
sentences.zh: 我想这可能比平时的人数要多。

sentences.en: And then, the moment we were waiting for, there was this mad dash of people swarming to the school bus yellow garbage truck and the white recycling truck.
sentences.zh: 然后，在我们等待的时刻，人们疯狂地涌向校车黄色的垃圾车和白色的回收车。

sentences.en: Okay, this one, yeah, people are tossing it in.
sentences.zh: 好的，这个，是的，人们正在把它扔进去。

sentences.en: Swiftly tossing their separate recyclables in the bins, tossing their blue bags in the garbage truck, and running away.
sentences.zh: 迅速地把各自的回收物扔进箱子里，把蓝色袋子扔进垃圾车，然后跑开。

sentences.en: It was madness.
sentences.zh: 那真是疯狂。

sentences.en: Like, extremely well-organized madness.
sentences.zh: 就像，极其井然有序的疯狂。

sentences.en: That was so chaotic.
sentences.zh: 那太混乱了。

sentences.en: And this system, for all its chaos, has been working.
sentences.zh: 而这个系统，尽管混乱，却一直行之有效。

sentences.en: Taipei City used to produce 3,296 tons of trash a day.
sentences.zh: 台北市过去每天产生3296吨垃圾。

sentences.en: Today, the city produces about 1,000 tons a day.
sentences.zh: 如今，该市每天产生约1000吨。

sentences.en: That is, according to Chen Weichie, one of 65 officials who supervised the garbage trucks and their routes.
sentences.zh: 这是根据陈伟杰（音译）的说法，他是监督垃圾车及其路线的65名官员之一。

sentences.en: I met him at a garbage pickup site, where Jasmine Wong acted as interpreter.
sentences.zh: 我在一个垃圾收集点见到了他，茉莉·黄担任翻译。

sentences.en: Everybody, this is Mr. Chen.
sentences.zh: 各位，这是陈先生。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: And he is his supervisor.
sentences.zh: 他是他的主管。

sentences.en: Hey.
sentences.zh: 嘿。

sentences.en: That's me.
sentences.zh: 那是我。

sentences.en: In his district, Chen oversees 20 garbage truck routes.
sentences.zh: 在他的辖区内，陈负责监督20条垃圾车路线。

sentences.en: And all those trucks have to make sure that citizens are sorting properly.
sentences.zh: 所有这些卡车都必须确保市民正确分类。

sentences.en: If they find garbage in the recycling bag, the people here will tell them that you cannot do that one more time.
sentences.zh: 如果他们在回收袋里发现垃圾，这里的人会告诉他们不能再那样做了。

sentences.en: Otherwise, you will get ticket.
sentences.zh: 否则，你会被开罚单。

sentences.en: And you might think, this is such a drag.
sentences.zh: 你可能会想，这真是太麻烦了。

sentences.en: There must be some people who buck the system by tossing their trash into public trash cans.
sentences.zh: 肯定有些人会通过把垃圾扔进公共垃圾桶来抵制这个系统。

sentences.en: Well, there are hardly any public trash cans in Taipei.
sentences.zh: 嗯，台北几乎没有公共垃圾桶。

sentences.en: They're only in train stations or at bus stops.
sentences.zh: 它们只在火车站或公交车站才有。

sentences.en: And those are little.
sentences.zh: 而且那些都很小。

sentences.en: They come up just below your knees.
sentences.zh: 它们的高度刚到你的膝盖下方。

sentences.en: So, in Taipei, for the most part, if you eat a candy or buy a coffee, you just take your empty coffee cup or your candy wrapper, put it in your pocket, and bring it home.
sentences.zh: 所以，在台北，大多数情况下，如果你吃糖果或买咖啡，你只需把空咖啡杯或糖果包装纸放进口袋，带回家。

sentences.en: It's your trash that you put in your blue bag and bring out to the truck yourself.
sentences.zh: 这是你自己的垃圾，你把它放进蓝色袋子里，自己带到卡车上。

sentences.en: It's hard to imagine a system like this working here in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 很难想象这样的系统在美国能行得通。

sentences.en: Every city here has a different method of trash pickup.
sentences.zh: 这里的每个城市都有不同的垃圾收集方法。

sentences.en: But across the board, the uniting factor is that our American trash pickup systems strive to be invisible.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，共同点是我们的美国垃圾收集系统力求隐形。

sentences.en: The trucks make great efforts to come when we're working or sleeping or trying to sleep, keeping out of the way of traffic and not disturbing the flow of the city.
sentences.zh: 卡车竭尽全力在我们工作、睡觉或试图睡觉时前来，避开交通，不干扰城市的流动。

sentences.en: We take our trash and our recycling out to bins or down a chute or to a dumpster, and it's gone.
sentences.zh: 我们把垃圾和回收物带到垃圾箱、滑槽或垃圾桶，然后它们就消失了。

sentences.en: We don't have to think about it.
sentences.zh: 我们不必去想它。

sentences.en: According to the EPA, Americans recycle and compost about 34% of their trash, which is less than most rich countries.
sentences.zh: 根据美国环保署的数据，美国人回收和堆肥了约34%的垃圾，这比大多数富裕国家都要少。

sentences.en: But some American cities do a lot better.
sentences.zh: 但一些美国城市做得好得多。

sentences.en: San Francisco has probably the most forward recycling program in North America.
sentences.zh: 旧金山可能拥有北美最先进的回收计划。

sentences.en: This is Robert Reed.
sentences.zh: 这是罗伯特·里德。

sentences.en: He's the representative of Recology, the company that takes care of San Francisco's waste, recycling, and compoSt.
sentences.zh: 他是Recology公司的代表，该公司负责处理旧金山的垃圾、回收和堆肥。

sentences.en: Unlike Taipei, which has a public trash pickup system, many waste pickup services in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 与拥有公共垃圾收集系统的台北不同，美国的许多垃圾收集服务

sentences.en: are private companies, and we are the customers.
sentences.zh: 是私营公司，而我们是客户。

sentences.en: That's how it works with Recology, which means they've got to keep their customers happy.
sentences.zh: Recology就是这样运作的，这意味着他们必须让客户满意。

sentences.en: Our number one focus is to provide superior customer service.
sentences.zh: 我们的首要重点是提供卓越的客户服务。

sentences.en: And our next focus is to do as much recycling as possible and to make recycling easy and convenient for customers.
sentences.zh: 我们的下一个重点是尽可能多地进行回收，并使回收对客户来说简单方便。

sentences.en: Recology has set up similar incentives to the system in Taipei, where trash pickup is way more expensive than recycling or compost pickup.
sentences.zh: Recology设立了类似于台北系统的激励措施，即垃圾收集费用远高于回收或堆肥收集费用。

sentences.en: For example, in San Francisco, recycling and compost cost about $2 a month per bin.
sentences.zh: 例如，在旧金山，回收和堆肥每个箱子每月花费约2美元。

sentences.en: Trash is about $26 a month per bin.
sentences.zh: 垃圾每个箱子每月约26美元。

sentences.en: But above all, Recology's system is meant to be simple and stress-free.
sentences.zh: 但最重要的是，Recology的系统旨在简单且无压力。

sentences.en: It has to be if you want people to keep paying for your service.
sentences.zh: 如果你想让人们继续为你的服务付费，就必须这样。

sentences.en: People have a lot of demands in their lives.
sentences.zh: 人们生活中有许多需求。

sentences.en: We understand that.
sentences.zh: 我们理解这一点。

sentences.en: You know, recycling might not be the very first thing.
sentences.zh: 你知道，回收可能不是第一要务。

sentences.en: They've got to make their boss happy.
sentences.zh: 他们必须让老板满意。

sentences.en: They've got to pay their mortgage.
sentences.zh: 他们必须支付抵押贷款。

sentences.en: Garbage and recycling and composting might not always be at the top of the liSt.
sentences.zh: 垃圾、回收和堆肥可能并不总是排在首位。

sentences.en: We understand that.
sentences.zh: 我们理解这一点。

sentences.en: Basically, instead of putting the onus on the citizens to separate the different kinds of compost and recycling for themselves,
sentences.zh: 基本上，Recology没有把自行分离不同种类堆肥和回收物的责任推给市民，

sentences.en: Recology does the brunt of the work.
sentences.zh: 而是承担了大部分工作。

sentences.en: Sorting.
sentences.zh: 分类。

sentences.en: So we don't have to.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不必这样做。

sentences.en: San Francisco, like a lot of other American cities that collect recycling, uses one catch-all recycling bin.
sentences.zh: 旧金山和许多其他收集可回收物的美国城市一样，使用一个统一的回收箱。

sentences.en: So you throw your cans, your bottles, your cardboard, all in the same place.
sentences.zh: 所以你把罐子、瓶子、纸板，全都扔在同一个地方。

sentences.en: And then all those different materials end up in a facility like Recycle Central.
sentences.zh: 然后所有这些不同的材料最终都会进入像“回收中心”这样的设施。

sentences.en: So this is Recycle Central.
sentences.zh: 这就是“回收中心”。

sentences.en: This is the large recycling plant on Pier 96, where we sort all the materials from the blue bin, the bottles, the cans, and the paper.
sentences.zh: 这是位于96号码头的大型回收工厂，我们在这里对蓝色回收箱里的所有材料进行分类，包括瓶子、罐子和纸张。

sentences.en: We're going to go inside now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在进去看看。

sentences.en: The facility is massive, and it's where Recology processes most of San Francisco's recycling.
sentences.zh: 该设施规模巨大，Recology公司大部分的旧金山回收业务都在这里处理。

sentences.en: You can see this great big pile of recycling.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到这一大堆回收物。

sentences.en: This is from this morning.
sentences.zh: 这是今天早上的。

sentences.en: This is from one day.
sentences.zh: 这只是一天的量。

sentences.en: And we're going to get this sorted out because we've got another big pile coming in tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们要把这些分拣出来，因为明天还有一大堆要运进来。

sentences.en: So we do 600 tons a day here.
sentences.zh: 我们这里每天处理600吨。

sentences.en: That 600-ton pile will wind its way up a huge, surreal web of conveyor belts,
sentences.zh: 那600吨的回收物将沿着一个巨大且超现实的传送带网络蜿蜒而上，

sentences.en: where some of the 173 people on staff will separate the recyclables into 16 categories of materials,
sentences.zh: 在173名员工的协助下，利用一些现代化的回收设备，

sentences.en: with the help of some modern recycling equipment.
sentences.zh: 将可回收物分成16类材料。

sentences.en: So we've got magnets, and we have fish ladders that separate bottles and cans from paper.
sentences.zh: 我们有磁铁，还有能把瓶罐和纸张分开的“鱼梯”。

sentences.en: They're on an angle, and they temporarily suspend gravity.
sentences.zh: 它们呈一定角度放置，能暂时抵消重力作用。

sentences.en: And to make sure everything gets precisely sorted, there's some real state-of-the-art technology,
sentences.zh: 为了确保一切都能精确分类，这里还有一些真正最先进的技术，

sentences.en: like this apparatus that separates clear plastic from color plastic with optic sensors.
sentences.zh: 比如这台利用光学传感器将透明塑料和彩色塑料分开的装置。

sentences.en: Right here, the scanner is looking at the materials as they come by,
sentences.zh: 就在这里，扫描仪在材料经过时进行观察，

sentences.en: and when it sees a clear plastic, like a clear plastic water bottle,
sentences.zh: 当它看到透明塑料，比如透明塑料水瓶时，

sentences.en: it hits it with a puff of air, and you can hear it.
sentences.zh: 它会喷出一股气流将其吹走，你甚至能听到声音。

sentences.en: It's expensive.
sentences.zh: 这很贵。

sentences.en: It costs $3 million for this machine, and it came from the Netherlands.
sentences.zh: 这台机器花了300万美元，是从荷兰进口的。

sentences.en: So this system, with all of its whirring, twirling conveyors and magnets and machinery and 173 employees,
sentences.zh: 所以这个系统，伴随着所有呼呼作响、旋转的传送带、磁铁、机械装置和173名员工，

sentences.en: it's dazzling.
sentences.zh: 真是令人眼花缭乱。

sentences.en: It makes less trash by doing more recycling.
sentences.zh: 它通过增加回收量来减少垃圾。

sentences.en: And recycling creates 10 times more jobs than landfilling or incineration.
sentences.zh: 而且回收利用创造的就业机会是填埋或焚烧的10倍。

sentences.en: Of course, it also takes all the direct sorting out of the hands of the people who actually create the waste,
sentences.zh: 当然，这也把直接分拣的工作从制造垃圾的人手中拿走了，

sentences.en: and charges them for the service instead.
sentences.zh: 转而向他们收取服务费。

sentences.en: As a result, recycling in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 结果就是，美国的回收利用

sentences.en: can be expensive.
sentences.zh: 可能很昂贵。

sentences.en: I guess that's part of the problem.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是问题的一部分。

sentences.en: Like, to the extent that there's pushback in recycling,
sentences.zh: 比如，在回收利用受到抵制的情况下，

sentences.en: which I've seen some of in the United States now,
sentences.zh: 我在美国已经看到了一些这样的情况，

sentences.en: it's often about the cost of it, and how it's very costly.
sentences.zh: 通常是因为它的成本，以及它非常昂贵。

sentences.en: And that's true if you're using the single-stream processes function,
sentences.zh: 如果你使用的是单流处理流程，确实如此，

sentences.en: and it's less true if the household does the separating.
sentences.zh: 但如果是家庭自己进行分类，情况就没那么严重了。

sentences.en: That's Professor Mary Alice Haddad again.
sentences.zh: 这是玛丽·爱丽丝·哈达德教授的观点。

sentences.en: If your community wants to recycle, all that stuff needs to be separated and sorted.
sentences.zh: 如果你的社区想要回收利用，所有这些东西都需要被分离和分拣。

sentences.en: Somehow.
sentences.zh: 总得有个办法。

sentences.en: Whether you use a $3 million machine from the Netherlands,
sentences.zh: 无论你是使用一台来自荷兰的300万美元机器，

sentences.en: or compel an entire sweet potato-shaped island of people to stand on the corner at night.
sentences.zh: 还是强迫整个番薯形状岛屿上的居民晚上站在街角。

sentences.en: The Taipei system is cheap and efficient because the city has conscripted their citizens as workers.
sentences.zh: 台北的系统既便宜又高效，因为该市把市民征召为工人。

sentences.en: And it's been successful.
sentences.zh: 而且它很成功。

sentences.en: Taipei is a great example of a big, major, global, metropolitan area
sentences.zh: 台北是一个大型、主要、全球化大都市的绝佳例子，

sentences.en: that did not have a good garbage collection system not that long ago.
sentences.zh: 不久前它还没有一个好的垃圾收集系统。

sentences.en: And they have completely transformed.
sentences.zh: 但他们已经彻底转型了。

sentences.en: And it could be an example for us all.
sentences.zh: 这可以成为我们所有人的榜样。

sentences.en: Which is not to say we should necessarily copy Taipei's system.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说我们一定要照搬台北的系统。

sentences.en: What's worked for them might not work for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 对他们有效的方法可能并不适用于美国。

sentences.en: But consider the American garbage truck, creeping around at dawn or during work hours,
sentences.zh: 但想想美国的垃圾车，在黎明或工作时间悄悄经过，

sentences.en: trying to be as inconspicuous as possible.
sentences.zh: 尽量做到不引人注意。

sentences.en: Trying to keep trash out of sight and out of mind.
sentences.zh: 试图让垃圾远离人们的视线和脑海。

sentences.en: You don't really pay attention to it.
sentences.zh: 你其实并不会去关注它。

sentences.en: But everyone should pay a lot of attention.
sentences.zh: 但每个人都应该多加关注。

sentences.en: If we had to watch our garbage pile up in our homes without taking it out to the bin,
sentences.zh: 如果我们不得不看着垃圾在家里堆积而不把它扔进垃圾箱，

sentences.en: and had to set aside time in our days to catch the garbage and recycling trucks coming down the street,
sentences.zh: 并且必须在每天留出时间去赶街上的垃圾车和回收车，

sentences.en: I bet we'd produce less junk.
sentences.zh: 我敢打赌我们会少制造些垃圾。

sentences.en: But I also think if I had to hear this song twice a night, five days a week,
sentences.zh: 但我也觉得，如果我每周五天，每天晚上都要听两次这首歌，

sentences.en: I would murder everybody.
sentences.zh: 我会杀了所有人。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Avery Truffelman,
sentences.zh: 本周的《99% Invisible》由艾弗里·特鲁费尔曼制作，

sentences.en: with Katie Mingle, Sam Greenspan, Delaney Hall,
sentences.zh: 凯蒂·明格尔、萨姆·格林斯潘、德莱尼·霍尔、

sentences.en: Kurt Colstead, Sharif Youssef, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 库尔特·科尔斯特德、谢里夫·优素福以及我，罗曼·马尔斯共同参与。

sentences.en: Special thanks this week to Helen Tsang, Aaron Newport, Ethan Young,
sentences.zh: 本周特别感谢海伦·曾、亚伦·纽波特、伊森·杨、

sentences.en: Sam Langton, and Jasmine Wong.
sentences.zh: 萨姆·兰顿和贾斯敏·黄。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7KALW in San Francisco
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山91.7 KALW电台的一个项目，

sentences.en: and produced under the offices of ArcSign,
sentences.zh: 在ArcSign的办公室下制作，

sentences.en: an architecture and interiors firm in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 这是一家位于加利福尼亚州奥克兰市中心美丽的建筑与室内设计公司。

sentences.en: You can find this show and like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在Facebook上找到并点赞我们的节目。

sentences.en: You can follow us all on Twitter and Instagram.
sentences.zh: 你可以在Twitter和Instagram上关注我们所有人。

sentences.en: We have a very good Tumblr that Avery takes care of.
sentences.zh: 我们有一个非常棒的Tumblr账号，由艾弗里负责打理。

sentences.en: But the best way to explore the 99% invisible activity that shapes the design of our world
sentences.zh: 但探索塑造我们世界设计的“99% Invisible”活动的最好方式，

sentences.en: is to do a deep dive on our website.
sentences.zh: 是深入浏览我们的网站。

sentences.en: It's 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 网址是99pi.org。
